
 Usage: openajar mcp [OPTIONS]

 openajar as a stdio MCP server, for any MCP client that starts a command
 (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Codex, `npx -y openajar`, `uvx openajar mcp`). It
 talks to openajar on this computer and starts it when it is stopped. Not set
 up yet? It still answers, and tells the agent and you what to run. Only MCP
 messages go to stdout; it exits when stdin closes.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
